## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and related task or issue.

## Validation

List commands/checks run, their results, and any checks still pending.

## Owner review and rollout

- [ ] Mark Allen Gbalazeh reviewed the latest diff, including AI-assisted changes.
- [ ] Required CI checks pass on the latest changes and review conversations are resolved.
- [ ] Architecture/API/data changes include the relevant decision and migration notes, where applicable.
- [ ] Rollback steps and material risks are documented, where applicable.
- [ ] No credentials or personal data are included in the change or its evidence.

KoloVibe has one developer. Self-review is recorded in this checklist; GitHub approval of the author's own PR is not required. AI assistance and self-review do not constitute independent security assurance. Completing this checklist does not activate branch protection or close release gates.
